dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: A family, indexed by a multidimensional plan and γ, containing an input array, one floating-point model for each positive ε, and a corresponding execution run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target is uniform over such a family; its constructor additionally certifies γ ≥ 0, model parameters ε and γ, and a common input for all runs.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: An m-axis transform plan consisting of m axis specifications and a proof that each prefix of exact axis transforms scales the normalized Euclidean norm by the square root of the product of the corresponding axis orders.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the axis plans, their dimensions, and the exact norm-scaling identities used by the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection plan.axis, mapping each i in Fin m to the i-th axis specification.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines every axis occurring in the coefficient sum, array index space, exact transform, and computed run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: The subtype of real numbers ε satisfying 0 < ε.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All quantified error parameters are strictly positive; ε = 0 is excluded.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: A certificate of per-axis local error bounds for a family, with nonnegative local quadratic coefficients and a positive common radius.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The theorem only concerns families for which this strong local-bound certificate is supplied, although the certificate is not explicitly referenced in the final inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: For an axis and γ, the first-order coefficient LocalDef022 of that axis's one-dimensional plan.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its values are summed over all m axes to form the linear coefficient in ε on the right-hand side.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: The exact output obtained by applying the recursive prefix transform through all m axes to the family's input.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its normalized Euclidean norm is the denominator of the relative error and is assumed strictly positive.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: For ε, the pointwise difference between the run's computed state at index 0 and the exact all-axis output.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its normalized Euclidean norm is the numerator of the relative forward-error bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: For an array x on the product index space, N(x) = ‖x‖₂ / sqrt(∏ᵢ nᵢ), where nᵢ is the order of axis i.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines both numerator and denominator of the stated relative error and all norm quantities in the plan and local-bound certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: The input-array projection of a family.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the common input from which the exact output and every computed run begin.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: The family constructor: it requires γ ≥ 0, an input, models parameterized by positive ε with model.epsilon = ε and model.gamma = γ, runs for those models, and run.input = input.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes nonnegativity of γ and consistency of all model and run parameters intrinsic assumptions whenever a family is supplied.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection returning the floating-point model associated with ε in a family.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines the arithmetic used by the ε-dependent computed run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection returning the execution run associated with ε.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines the computed output and local residuals appearing in the error quantities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: An axis specification containing a positive order and a one-dimensional transform plan for that order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Each axis fixes one cyclic coordinate size and one staged transform whose coefficient contributes to the bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural-number order of an axis specification.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines a cyclic coordinate ZMod(order), the total array dimension, and norm-scaling factors.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: The one-dimensional staged transform plan stored in an axis specification.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines the axis transform and its first-order coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of complex arrays on the multidimensional index set ∏ᵢ ZMod((axis i).order).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the common space of inputs, exact outputs, computed states, and errors.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multidimensional-plan constructor from an axis family and the identity N(T_k x) = sqrt(P_k) N(x) for every k ≤ m and array x, where P_k is the product of the first k axis orders.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Requires exact prefix transforms to have the prescribed Euclidean norm scaling.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: The axis-bound constructor: it takes cᵢ ≥ 0 and r > 0 such that, for every positive ε ≤ r and axis i, N(T_i dᵢ) ≤ ε Aᵢ(γ) N(T_{i+1} s_{i+1}) + cᵢ ε², where dᵢ is the local computed-minus-exact axis residual.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Encodes the local first-plus-second-order hypotheses from which the global existential bound is asserted.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: The recursive exact prefix transform T₀(x) = x and T_{k+1}(x) = T_k(F_k x), with an out-of-range axis operation acting as the identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the exact output, prefix norm identities, and transformed local residuals.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: Every axis order is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Ensures each cyclic axis and its square-root normalization are based on a positive natural size.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a one-dimensional plan with stages s, A(γ) = Σₛ c(radixₛ,γ) + (stageCount - 1)(3 + 2γ), where subtraction and casting occur in the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Gives the exact per-axis first-order coefficient used in the final sum.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: The product of all axis orders.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its square root normalizes every multidimensional Euclidean norm.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: The computed state at index 0 of a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is treated as the run's final computed output.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ordinary Euclidean norm of a finite complex array: sqrt(Σ over all indices of |x(index)|²).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms the numerator of the normalized norm before division by the square root of the total dimension.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: Pointwise subtraction of two complex arrays.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines both the global computed-minus-exact error and each local residual.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: The axis constructor from an order n, a proof n > 0, and a one-dimensional plan of size n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes positivity of every axis order intrinsic to a supplied plan.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: Every axis order is strictly positive.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Rules out zero-length axes and justifies the relevant NeZero instances.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: A staged one-dimensional transform plan for arrays indexed by ZMod n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines each exact and floating axis transform and the coefficient Aᵢ(γ).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: The stage indexed by a finite stage number in a one-dimensional plan.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its radix contributes to the coefficient and its operation contributes to exact and floating transforms.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: The number of stages in a one-dimensional plan.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Indexes the stages and appears as stageCount - 1 in the coefficient formula.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: The radix of a stage.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Controls the stage transform implementation and its piecewise first-order coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: The dependent product index type (i : Fin m) ↦ ZMod((axis i).order).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Specifies every coordinate of a multidimensional complex array.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: An execution record for a plan and floating-point model, containing an input and m + 1 computed states satisfying the algorithm recurrence.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the computed output and all intermediate states used in local and global errors.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef035
dependency_coverage.meaning: The computed-state array of a run, indexed by Fin(m + 1).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: State 0 is the output, state m is the input, and adjacent states determine local residuals.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef036
dependency_coverage.meaning: The input projection of a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Family consistency requires it to equal the common family input.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef037
dependency_coverage.meaning: A floating-point model with positive ε, nonnegative γ, approximate real addition, multiplication, sine and cosine, and a complex input-rounding function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the arithmetic used to construct every computed state.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef038
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ε field of a floating-point model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Family consistency equates it to the quantified positive ε.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef039
dependency_coverage.meaning: The γ field of a floating-point model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Family consistency equates it to the target's γ parameter.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef040
dependency_coverage.meaning: The radix contribution c(q,γ): sqrt(2) if q = 2; 5 if q = 4; otherwise 2 sqrt(q)(q + γ).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Appears inside every axis's first-order coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef041
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that the natural numeral 1 + 1 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Only supports elaboration of the numeral 2 in casts and powers; it adds no substantive hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef042
dependency_coverage.meaning: A dependent case split on a natural number into zero and successor cases.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Implements the recursion defining prefix transforms and has no independent mathematical condition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef043
dependency_coverage.meaning: For natural i, applies the exact DFT along axis i when i < m and otherwise returns the array unchanged.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides each step F_i in the exact prefix transform.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef044
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that 2 + 1 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports elaboration of the real numeral 3 in the coefficient formula.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef045
dependency_coverage.meaning: For every m, m + 1 is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports finite indexing of the m + 1 run states.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef046
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite-type structure on the product of all cyclic axis index sets.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes sums and products over every array index finite.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef047
dependency_coverage.meaning: For k ≤ m, the product of the orders of axes 0 through k - 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the exact square-root norm-scaling factor for T_k.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef048
dependency_coverage.meaning: For run and axis i, T_i(s_i - F_i(s_{i+1})), where s_j denotes computedState j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its normalized norm is the local error quantity bounded by the axisBounds certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef049
dependency_coverage.meaning: For run and axis i, N(T_{i+1}(s_{i+1})).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the state-dependent multiplier in the first-order part of each local error bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef050
dependency_coverage.meaning: The one-dimensional-plan constructor: stages have positive count, radices whose product is n, prescribed twiddle flags, and an exact staged transform equal to the unnormalized DFT up to a final permutation; it also requires stage and full-DFT norm-scaling facts.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Restricts admissible plans to factorizations implementing the exact unnormalized DFT with the stated norm behavior.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef051
dependency_coverage.meaning: A transform stage containing a radix, block decomposition, reindexing and permutation equivalences, a twiddle flag, and twiddle exponents.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines one exact or floating stage and contributes its radix to the error coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef052
dependency_coverage.meaning: The run constructor: the model's input-rounding function fixes every input component, state m equals the input, and state i is obtained by applying the floating axis-i transform to state i + 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Precisely constrains computed outputs and intermediate states; in particular, the supplied input must be fixed by flInput.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef053
dependency_coverage.meaning: The floating model constructor. Addition has independent relative perturbations on its two operands bounded by ε; multiplication has one relative perturbation bounded by ε; sine and cosine have absolute perturbations bounded by γε; ε > 0 and γ ≥ 0. The complex input function is otherwise unrestricted.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the exact arithmetic error model underlying computed runs; exact representability of the actual input is imposed separately by the run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef054
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that 4 + 1 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports elaboration of the real numeral 5 in the radix-4 coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef055
dependency_coverage.meaning: The local residual s_i - F_i(s_{i+1}) at axis i.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: After applying T_i, this is the local error measured by LocalDef048.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef056
dependency_coverage.meaning: The exact unnormalized DFT along axis i: at index k it sums χ(j k_i)x(k with coordinate i replaced by j) over j in ZMod(n_i), using the standard additive character χ.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines each exact axis operation F_i.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef057
dependency_coverage.meaning: Every selected axis has nonzero order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the finite cyclic group and standard additive character needed for each axis DFT.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef058
dependency_coverage.meaning: An auxiliary two-constructor type carried by a one-dimensional plan constructor, with no operations or semantic properties exposed here.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Only contributes inert plan data; it does not occur in the target formula or impose a numerical condition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef059
dependency_coverage.meaning: The stage constructor requires radix ≥ 2, nonzero block count, blockCount·radix = n, a block/radix reindexing equivalence, a permutation, a Boolean twiddle choice, and a twiddle-exponent map.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Ensures each stage is a valid factorization step of the one-dimensional transform.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef060
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Boolean field indicating whether a stage applies twiddle factors.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Selects whether exact and floating stage outputs are multiplied by twiddle factors.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef061
dependency_coverage.meaning: The model's complex input-rounding function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A run may exist only when this function fixes every component of the chosen input.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef062
dependency_coverage.meaning: Left-fold composition of all exact stages in their finite order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used in the plan certificate that staged exact computation equals the full DFT up to final permutation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef063
dependency_coverage.meaning: The unnormalized Euclidean norm sqrt(Σ_j |x_j|²) of a one-dimensional complex array.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Appears in stage norm-scaling certificates and defines the normalized one-dimensional norm.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef064
dependency_coverage.meaning: The one-dimensional normalized Euclidean norm ‖x‖₂/sqrt(n).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Appears in the plan certificate that the full unnormalized DFT scales normalized norm by sqrt(n).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef065
dependency_coverage.meaning: The unnormalized one-dimensional DFT x ↦ (k ↦ Σ_j χ(jk)x_j).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The exact staged plan is required to implement this transform up to final permutation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef066
dependency_coverage.meaning: An exact stage: first performs the radix-size block DFT and then conditionally applies exact twiddle factors.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the ideal counterpart of each floating stage.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef067
dependency_coverage.meaning: Reindexes an array by a supplied permutation: output i is input(permutation i).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applies the final plan permutation and stage permutations without changing Euclidean norm.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef068
dependency_coverage.meaning: Applies the complete floating one-dimensional plan of axis i to each slice obtained by varying coordinate i.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the recurrence from computed state i + 1 to computed state i.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef069
dependency_coverage.meaning: One nullary constructor of the auxiliary type LocalDef058.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides possible inert plan data and has no direct numerical effect.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef070
dependency_coverage.meaning: The other nullary constructor of the auxiliary type LocalDef058.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides possible inert plan data and has no direct numerical effect.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef071
dependency_coverage.meaning: The sum Σ_i |x_i|² over a finite cyclic index set.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its square root is the one-dimensional Euclidean norm.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef072
dependency_coverage.meaning: The exact radix stage before twiddles: permute the input, use the inverse reindexing to identify a block and within-block frequency, and sum the standard-character-weighted values across that block.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the exact butterfly/block DFT for a stage.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef073
dependency_coverage.meaning: Conditionally multiplies each component by the exact standard-character value at its twiddle exponent.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Completes the exact stage when useTwiddle is true.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef074
dependency_coverage.meaning: The complete floating one-dimensional transform: fold the model-dependent floating stages and then apply the plan's final permutation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the floating transform used independently on slices of each multidimensional axis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef075
dependency_coverage.meaning: The final permutation stored in a one-dimensional plan.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Reindexes both exact-plan certification and floating-plan output.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef076
dependency_coverage.meaning: The number of radix blocks stored in a stage.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with the radix it equals the one-dimensional transform size.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef077
dependency_coverage.meaning: The input permutation stored in a stage.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines which input values enter each stage block.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef078
dependency_coverage.meaning: The equivalence between block/radix pairs and ZMod n stored in a stage.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the block decomposition and recombination used by exact and floating stage transforms.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef079
dependency_coverage.meaning: The stage's map from output indices to twiddle exponents.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Chooses the root of unity used for each conditional twiddle multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef080
dependency_coverage.meaning: Left-fold composition of all model-dependent floating stages.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms the pre-permutation floating result of a one-dimensional plan.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef081
dependency_coverage.meaning: Every stage radix is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies finite cyclic indexing and root-of-unity definitions for stage computations.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef082
dependency_coverage.meaning: A floating stage: perform the floating radix block transform, then conditionally apply floating twiddle multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines each step in the floating one-dimensional computation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef083
dependency_coverage.meaning: The floating block transform, selecting specialized radix-2 or radix-4 routines when applicable and otherwise a generic radix-q DFT routine.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines the arithmetic operation sequence whose errors are represented by the per-radix coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef084
dependency_coverage.meaning: Conditionally multiplies each stage output by a floating approximation of its twiddle root using floating complex multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Adds model-dependent twiddle error when useTwiddle is true.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef085
dependency_coverage.meaning: Floating complex multiplication computed from four model multiplications and two model additions, with the real subtraction represented as addition of a negated product.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Implements generic root multiplication and twiddle multiplication in floating stages.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef086
dependency_coverage.meaning: The generic floating radix-q DFT: form floating roots, multiply them by inputs with floating complex multiplication, and sequentially sum real and imaginary parts using floating addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used for stage radices other than 2 and 4.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef087
dependency_coverage.meaning: Symmetry of an equality asserting that a stage radix equals 2.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Only transports indices into the specialized radix-2 routine; it adds no condition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef088
dependency_coverage.meaning: Symmetry of an equality asserting that a stage radix equals 4.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Only transports indices into the specialized radix-4 routine; it adds no condition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef089
dependency_coverage.meaning: A specialized radix-4 DFT using exact multiplications by 1, i, -1, and -i, followed by a fixed binary tree of floating complex additions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the radix-4 arithmetic path associated with coefficient 5.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef090
dependency_coverage.meaning: A specialized radix-2 DFT using exact signs and sequential floating complex summation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the radix-2 arithmetic path associated with coefficient sqrt(2).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef091
dependency_coverage.meaning: The floating complex root at residue j, with real part flCos(2π·j.val/q) and imaginary part flSin(2π·j.val/q).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies approximate roots for generic DFT and twiddle multiplications.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef092
dependency_coverage.meaning: The model's approximate real addition operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used throughout floating complex addition and multiplication and controlled by the model's addition error axiom.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef093
dependency_coverage.meaning: The model's approximate cosine operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used to form floating roots and controlled by an absolute error at most γε.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef094
dependency_coverage.meaning: The model's approximate real multiplication operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used throughout floating complex multiplication and controlled by the model's relative error axiom.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef095
dependency_coverage.meaning: The model's approximate sine operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used to form floating roots and controlled by an absolute error at most γε.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef096
dependency_coverage.meaning: Exact multiplication by the four fourth roots: j = 0 gives x, j = 1 gives ix, j = 2 gives -x, and j = 3 gives -ix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Avoids floating trigonometry and multiplication in the specialized radix-4 routine.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef097
dependency_coverage.meaning: Exact multiplication by the two second roots: x for residue 0 and -x otherwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Avoids floating trigonometry and multiplication in the specialized radix-2 routine.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef098
dependency_coverage.meaning: The angle 2π·j.val/q associated with j in ZMod q.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Is the argument supplied to floating sine and cosine when forming a root.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef099
dependency_coverage.meaning: Componentwise floating complex addition using model.flAdd on real and imaginary parts.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Combines terms in specialized radix-4 transforms.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef100
dependency_coverage.meaning: Sequentially sums a finite family of complex terms by applying the supplied floating addition separately to real and imaginary parts.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Combines terms in generic and radix-2 floating DFTs.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef101
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that 3 + 1, namely 4, is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports finite indexing and ZMod 4 in the specialized radix-4 routine.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef102
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that 1 + 1, namely 2, is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports finite indexing and ZMod 2 in the specialized radix-2 routine.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef103
dependency_coverage.meaning: A left-associated finite fold using a supplied binary operation: it returns 0 for no entries, the sole value for one entry, and repeatedly combines the accumulated prefix with the last value thereafter.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Fixes the exact order of floating additions in finite complex summation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef104
dependency_coverage.meaning: If n = 0, then 0 < n + 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies a bound needed to index the sole element in the base case of finite summation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef105
dependency_coverage.meaning: A dependent natural-number case eliminator specialized to finite real vectors.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Implements the zero/successor cases of the sequential sum and adds no mathematical assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Requires C ≥ 0 together with the existence of a radius, and radius > 0 together with the universal bound.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The division operation supplied by a division-inverse monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Selects ordinary real division in normalized norms and in the relative-error ratio.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists
dependency_coverage.meaning: Existential quantification.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Introduces a nonnegative second-order coefficient and a positive radius, with the radius allowed to depend on the coefficient and all preceding data.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin n is the finite type of natural indices 0 through n - 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Indexes the m axes, plan stages, and run states.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite enumeration structure on Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Allows summation over every axis index.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum
dependency_coverage.meaning: Finite summation in an additive commutative monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms the sum of all m axis coefficients and several underlying norm and transform sums.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite set containing every element of a finite type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes the coefficient sum range over all axes and other finite sums range over complete index sets.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous addition operation selected by an HAdd instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Specializes to ordinary real addition in the right-hand side Cε² + εΣAᵢ.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous division operation selected by an HDiv instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Specializes to ordinary real division in the relative-error ratio and norm normalizations.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous multiplication operation selected by an HMul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Specializes to ordinary real multiplication in both first- and second-order terms.

binders: m is a natural number equipped with NeZero m, hence m ≠ 0 and therefore m ≥ 1.
plan is an m-axis transform plan. Write axis i for its i-th axis, nᵢ > 0 for that axis's order, and pᵢ for its one-dimensional staged plan.
family is a plan- and γ-indexed family containing a common complex input x, a floating-point model Mε for every positive real ε, and a corresponding run Rε.
axisBounds is a certificate of common-radius per-axis local error estimates for this family.
hexactOutput is the hypothesis that the normalized Euclidean norm of the exact all-axis output is strictly positive.
The conclusion existentially binds a real secondOrderCoeff C and, inside its scope, a real radius ρ; thus ρ may depend on C and all preceding data.
hypotheses: Each axis i has a positive order nᵢ and a staged one-dimensional transform plan whose stage radices are at least 2, whose product is nᵢ, and whose exact staged computation implements the unnormalized cyclic DFT up to a final permutation.
Let I = ∏_{i=0}^{m-1} ZMod(nᵢ), and let arrays be functions I → ℂ.
For an array z, define N(z) = (Σ_{k∈I}|z(k)|²)^(1/2) / sqrt(∏ᵢ nᵢ).

Let Fᵢ be the exact unnormalized DFT along coordinate i, using the standard additive character. Define T₀(z) = z and T_{k+1}(z) = T_k(F_k(z)). The plan certifies N(T_k(z)) = sqrt(∏_{i<k} nᵢ) N(z) for every k ≤ m and every z.
The exact output is y = T_m(x), and N(y) > 0.
The family intrinsically contains a proof γ ≥ 0. For each positive ε, its model has model.epsilon = ε and model.gamma = γ.

The model's addition satisfies flAdd(a,b) = a(1 + θa ε) + b(1 + θb ε) for some |θa| ≤ 1 and |θb| ≤ 1; multiplication satisfies flMul(a,b) = ab(1 + θε) for some |θ| ≤ 1; sine and cosine differ from their exact values by γθε for some |θ| ≤ 1.
For each ε, the run has states s₀,…,s_m with s_m = x and sᵢ equal to the floating axis-i transform of s_{i+1}; the model's input-rounding function fixes every component of x.
The axisBounds certificate supplies nonnegative numbers cᵢ and a common r₀ > 0 such that, for every positive ε ≤ r₀ and every i, N(T_i(sᵢ - Fᵢ(s_{i+1}))) ≤ ε Aᵢ(γ) N(T_{i+1}(s_{i+1})) + cᵢ ε².
conclusions: For that C, there exists a real radius ρ > 0.
For every positive real ε with ε ≤ ρ, the normalized relative forward error satisfies N(s₀ - y) / N(y) ≤ ε Σ_{i=0}^{m-1} Aᵢ(γ) + C ε².
mathematical_definitions: For a one-dimensional plan p with t stages of radices q₀,…,q_{t-1}, define A(p,γ) = Σ_{s=0}^{t-1} c(q_s,γ) + (t - 1)(3 + 2γ), where t - 1 is computed after casting t to the reals.
The radix contribution is c(q,γ) = sqrt(2) when q = 2, c(q,γ) = 5 when q = 4, and c(q,γ) = 2 sqrt(q)(q + γ) otherwise.
Aᵢ(γ) denotes A(pᵢ,γ) for the one-dimensional plan stored in axis i.
The computed error at ε is eε = s₀ - y, pointwise over I.
Because both numerator and denominator use the same normalized norm N, their common factor 1/sqrt(∏ᵢ nᵢ) cancels algebraically, although the Lean proposition states the quotient using N explicitly.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every nonempty collection of transform axes, every admissible multidimensional staged transform plan, every compatible family of floating-point executions with nonnegative trigonometric-error parameter γ, and every supplied certificate of sufficiently small per-axis first-plus-second-order local errors, if the exact transformed output has nonzero normalized Euclidean norm, then there are a nonnegative constant C and a positive radius ρ such that every positive ε ≤ ρ has relative forward error at most ε times the sum of the explicitly defined per-axis first-order coefficients, plus Cε².

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The theorem applies only for m ≠ 0; the zero-axis case is excluded.
Every axis order is strictly positive, every stage count is strictly positive, every stage radix is at least 2, and the stage radices must factor the corresponding axis order.
Although γ is introduced as an arbitrary real binder, supplying a family intrinsically requires γ ≥ 0.
The input must be fixed pointwise by each model's input-rounding function; arbitrary non-representable inputs are not covered by these run objects.
The per-axis local error bounds are assumptions packaged in axisBounds. The target does not derive them from the primitive floating arithmetic axioms.
The relative bound is conditional on N(y) > 0. If the exact output norm is zero, the implication is vacuously true and provides no bound.
Only strictly positive ε are quantified. No assertion is made at ε = 0.
The estimate is local in ε: no assertion is made for ε > ρ.

The existential constants C and ρ may depend on m, the plan, γ, the family, the axisBounds certificate, and the positive-output proof. No uniformity across different plans, inputs, families, or dimensions is encoded.
C is only required to be nonnegative and is neither explicit nor claimed to be optimal or unique; likewise, ρ is not explicit or maximal.
The conclusion bounds relative forward error, not absolute error, componentwise error, backward error, or probability of error.
The final first-order coefficient is exactly Σᵢ Aᵢ(γ); the proposition does not replace it by a simpler asymptotic expression.

Dependent types can themselves be uninhabited for data failing their constructor conditions. Universal quantification over plan, family, or axisBounds values imposes no obligation for parameter combinations where no such value exists.
ambiguities: The dossier exposes the exact DFT weights through ZMod.stdAddChar but does not expand the underlying ZMod-to-circle map far enough to determine from this packet alone whether the conventional complex exponential is written with a positive or negative phase. The translation therefore retains the exact phrase "standard additive character" rather than choosing a sign convention.
LocalDef058 has two nullary constructors but no supplied semantic labels or operational use, so it can only be identified as inert auxiliary plan data.
